program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(2 * apexTime, time)); const tossedHeight = launchSpeed * t - (gravity * t * t) / 2; const tossedVelocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const tossedAcceleration = -gravity; let dropHeight = apexHeight; let dropVelocity = 0; let dropAcceleration = 0; if (t >= apexTime) { const dt = t - apexTime; dropHeight = apexHeight - (gravity * dt * dt) / 2; dropVelocity = -gravity * dt; dropAcceleration = -gravity; } let tossState = "At launch"; if (t > 0 && t < apexTime) tossState = "Rising"; else if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) < 0.01) tossState = "At the top"; else if (t > apexTime && tossedHeight > 0.05) tossState = "Falling"; else if (t >= apexTime && tossedHeight <= 0.05) tossState = "At launch height"; let dropState = "Held in place"; if (t > apexTime && t < apexTime + 0.05) dropState = "Just released"; else if (t >= apexTime + 0.05 && dropHeight > 0.05) dropState = "Falling together"; else if (dropHeight <= 0.05 && t > apexTime) dropState = "At launch height"; const width = 640; const height = 420; const laneW = 280; const laneH = 300; const yTop = 80; const tossX = 40; const dropX = 330; const maxH = 2.2; const scaleY = laneH / maxH; const toScreenY = (hVal) => yTop + laneH - hVal * scaleY; const tossBallY = toScreenY(Math.max(0, Math.min(maxH, tossedHeight))); const dropBallY = toScreenY(Math.max(0, Math.min(maxH, dropHeight))); const gateY = toScreenY(apexHeight); const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: tossX, y: yTop - 28, w: laneW, h: laneH + 28, title: "Toss lane", state: tossState, id: "lane.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: dropX, y: yTop - 28, w: laneW, h: laneH + 28, title: "Drop lane", state: dropState, id: "lane.drop" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.toss", { x: tossX + 40, y: yTop + laneH, length: laneH, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 1.1, 2.2], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.drop", { x: dropX + 40, y: yTop + laneH, length: laneH, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 1.1, 2.2], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", tossX + 140, tossBallY, 24, { role: "output" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.drop", dropX + 140, dropBallY, 24, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.toss", { x: tossX + 110, y: tossBallY }, { value: tossedVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, minLength: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.toss", { x: tossX + 170, y: tossBallY }, { value: tossedAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 5, minLength: 12, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.drop", { x: dropX + 110, y: dropBallY }, { value: dropVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, minLength: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.drop", { x: dropX + 170, y: dropBallY }, { value: dropAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 5, minLength: 12, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(tossX + 195, tossBallY - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(tossedVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(tossedAcceleration, 1) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(dropX + 195, dropBallY - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(dropVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(dropAcceleration, 1) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.drop" })); objects.push(...sdk.gate("gate", dropX + 140, gateY, { open: t >= apexTime, w: 40, label: "Apex Gate" })); return { frame: { width, height, objects, readouts: [{ id: "tossedVelocity", value: tossedVelocity }, { id: "tossedAcceleration", value: tossedAcceleration }, { id: "dropVelocity", value: dropVelocity }, { id: "dropAcceleration", value: dropAcceleration }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, apexTime, apexHeight, tossedVelocity, tossedAcceleration, tossedHeight, dropVelocity, dropAcceleration, dropHeight } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps pulling at -g. A second ball released at that moment falls alongside the toss.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side vertical lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball. Velocity and acceleration vectors and readouts update as time progresses.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
